text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Just now, Boo-chan was hungry, 
so Ms. Big cooked her a meal!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I see... is that so. To fill the belly of 
the hungry 
is a most noble duty indeed. 
Brian especially is a great eater, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And what manner of dish 
did you serve her?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
A fluffy omelet packed full of meat, 
and consommé soup with veggies snuck in! 
It's a Big-size meal that'll make you grow 
Big!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly, I was thinking vinegared 
horse mackerel 
might be nice too, but—

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Boo-chan isn't fond of that kind of thing, 
and if I'm cooking anyway, I figured 
something 
she'd be happy about would be better!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
My, my... you have my sympathies for all 
that effort. 
To put another before yourself—how 
admirable a spirit.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
But then... hehe. 
If that is the case, Lady Big must be 
hungry 
as well. Shall I prepare something?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Vinegared horse mackerel, simmered 
eggplant— 
and I shall prepare a chawanmushi as well.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Really!? 
Then how about we eat together in our dorm 
room? 
A Japanese-food party, just for us 
roommates!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let us do that. 
It promises to be a merry feast.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Yep! ♪ I'll cook the rice 
and brew the tea~! ♪ If there's anything 
else 
I can help with, just say the word!
